images.prompt: Interior reference image, 3:2 landscape, ordinary realistic present-day city, no magic, no fantasy elements. A second camera angle of the same waiting hall: the camera stands at or beside the entrance and looks back, so the entrance area reads immediately in the foreground of the frame while the adjacent bench seating area is seen beyond it; include the platform door only if that geometry is what the selected main image shows. Preserve every structural and material fact of the selected main image: same architecture, same walls, same ceiling, same floor, same door and window design, same fixtures, same lighting, same color grading, same proportions. Fixed and only confirmed relationships: the entrance is adjacent to the bench seating area, and the bench seating area leads to the platform door. Do not arrange these three elements on a single straight axis, do not make them coaxial, facing, mirrored, left–right ordered, or north–south aligned; relative placement must match the selected main image and nothing more. Do not add rooms, corridors, stairs, extra doors, signage text, furniture, plants, or vehicles. No electronic devices and no digital displays anywhere: every fixture and prop is mechanical or hand-made. Keep the same rendering style and lighting as the selected main image; human figures absent unless the selected main image establishes an anchor figure.

images.prompt:
Composition: Clean 3:2 landscape layout on a warm off-white background with generous spacing. No frames, borders, dividers, text, labels, watermarks, or logos. Soft, even neutral studio lighting across all panels. Rendering style, line weight, texture, and shading must strictly match the reference image.
Left Column (20% width): Exactly one large, straight-on head-and-shoulders portrait of the reference subject with a neutral expression. Clearly show the face and hairstyle. No expression grid, no stacked portraits, no additional head crops.
Right Row (80% width): Exactly three full-height, identically scaled figures arranged left to right: Front View, Back View, and Clean Side Profile. Neutral relaxed stance, head to feet visible in every figure, including shoes. Soft oval floor shadows. The face portrait and all three full-body views show the same subject.
Consistency & Constraints: Preserve exact identity, hair, facial features, garments, asymmetry, and accessories from the reference. Do not add, redesign, beautify, age, or extrapolate items based on lore/profession. No extra characters, shifting proportions, extra limbs, or style drift.
Subject-specific constraints: The subject is a night-shift female administrator with short black hair that contains one lock of white hair — keep exactly one white streak, in the same position and width as the reference, with the same short black haircut. Wardrobe is fixed and must be preserved exactly: a long grey coat and dark blue trousers; do not shorten, recolor, restyle, layer, or accessorize them. No props of any kind: no electronic devices, no badge, no bag, no tools, no weapon. The subject is intact and unharmed: no blood, bandages, or injury makeup. Same warm off-white studio background, same lighting and line treatment in every panel.

messages.text: 检查这个项目所有已有实体、变体和关系是否与世界规则一致。特别核对林岚携带的物品，不要只读摘要。区分明确矛盾、缺少资料和设计建议。场景朝向／尺寸／完整平面布局与人物声音尚未提供，不能当作已经确定的错误，也不能猜方向。没有选图，不要声称图像一致。保存项目一致性检查报告，不修改资料。

我先读取一致性检查方法，并把五个实体的完整资料（不只摘要）逐个读出来。

我已逐个读取五个实体的完整资料（含关系、空间、派生来源），不是只看摘要。下面保存检查报告。

检查报告已保存（提案 ID `fe8c7a53-121b-4033-b61e-a76adb16f45c`，仅审阅意见，未改动任何资料）。方法说明：五个实体我都调用了完整资料读取，不是只看摘要；本轮没有选定图片，因此未做也不主张任何图像一致性结论。

**明确矛盾（2 条，都围绕同一件物品）**

1. `电子腕表`（93bcbad8）完整描述为「电子显示和电池供电的腕表」、外观「黑色电子屏幕」，与世界规则「不允许电子设备，所有道具是机械或手工物品」直接冲突——这是两条已确认事实互相打架，不是缺资料。
2. 关系「林岚—携带→电子腕表」（relationId d43525b2）使林岚在项目事实中携带电子设备，同样与规则冲突；该关系自己的说明原本就写着「尚需检查世界规则」。

**缺少资料（不当作错误）**

- 变体「林岚·腕伤」是否继承这件携带物没有明文：派生说明写「唯一改变项是绷带，其余不变」，但变体关系只有「派生自」和「装备使用白色绷带」（创建时 copySettingRelations=false）。
- 腕表的剧情作用（projectRole 全空）与佩戴部位（哪只手、是否外露）未登记；基础林岚外观也只写了外套与裤子，没提任何携带物。
- 旧候车厅空间为 missing、draft 为空，朝向／尺寸／布局属尚未提供——按你的要求未作错误、未猜方向，「相邻」「通向」不等于同轴或直线。
- 项目 visualStyle 为空、剧情关系为空、人物声音全空。

**相符之处**（也一并核对了）：白色绷带为纯棉手工物品、明确无电子元件，符合规则；林岚·腕伤只改右手腕且保留身份与灰色长外套、深蓝裤子，符合「伤势不改变人物身份与已有服装」；无魔法元素。

**设计建议**：绷带宽度／包扎层数／卷尾是否露出未定，若要做图可补；另发现派生关系记录的 targetRevision 与基础林岚当前 sourceRevision 不一致，可能表示变体基于腕表关系加入之前的版本，建议定案后复核同步，本次不判为冲突。

想请你定三件事：① 腕表是改成机械／手动上链腕表，还是保留电子设备而改世界规则？② 该物品是否真的是剧情需要，还是导入残留可以删除？③ 变体是否携带它，若携带戴在哪只手？定了①我再把变体与关系的影响面一并列出。

issues.description: 明确矛盾：世界规则写「不允许电子设备，所有道具是机械或手工物品」，而「电子腕表」完整资料为「电子显示和电池供电的腕表」，外观写「黑色电子屏幕」。该物品即使不使用也是电子设备本体，与规则直接冲突；这不是资料缺失，是两条已确认事实互相矛盾。
issues.suggestion: 请用户在两种方向中择一：① 改为机械腕表（手动上链、无屏幕无电池，可保留黑色表盘），需同步修改名称、描述、外观，并重命名实体；② 保留电子设备，则须修改项目世界规则——该规则已写入项目字段，需在网页确认后生效。决定前不要在提示词或场景中把该物品当作可用道具。

issues.description: 明确矛盾：关系「林岚—携带→电子腕表」（relationId d43525b2）使林岚在项目事实中携带电子设备，与世界规则冲突。该关系自己的说明已写「导入资料中的携带关系，尚需检查世界规则」，说明它原本就是待核项，而核对结果与规则不相容。
issues.suggestion: 与上一条一并决定：若改为机械腕表，则更新该携带关系指向新物品并改写说明；若删除电子腕表，则停用/撤销该携带关系。同时补记佩戴部位（左手或右手腕、外露或藏在袖内），以判断与变体右手腕绷带是否重叠。

issues.description: 缺少资料：「电子腕表」的剧情作用（projectRole 的 role 与 plotNotes 均为空）未登记，携带关系也未说明佩戴部位。因此无法判断它是剧情必需道具、还是导入时残留的普通配饰，也无法判断它与变体腕伤区域的相对位置。
issues.suggestion: 请补充该物品的剧情作用（是否需要计时、是否与夜班值守情节相关）与佩戴部位；若确认只是导入残留，建议明确删除物品与关系。另：基础林岚外观只登记灰色长外套与深蓝裤子、未提任何携带物，若不保留该物品，任何图像提示词都不应自行添加腕表。

issues.description: 缺少资料：变体「林岚·腕伤」是否继承基础林岚的携带物未说明。派生关系写「唯一改变项是右手腕绷带，其余保持不变」，但变体的关系只有「派生自」与「装备使用白色绷带」（创建选项 copySettingRelations=false），没有与腕表的携带关系。两种读法（继承／不继承）目前都无明文依据，属于资料缺口而非已确认矛盾。
issues.suggestion: 请明确：变体是否携带同一计时道具。若继承，补登记该携带关系并注明手腕；若不继承，建议在派生说明中补一句「不携带基础林岚的计时道具」，以免后续图像或场景把它误读成默认继承。在物品本身矛盾解决前，此项不宜先行定稿。

issues.description: 提示核对（不作为确定错误）：派生关系记录的 targetRevision 为 31c02a82…，而基础林岚当前 sourceRevision 为 2b78f33f…，两者不一致；时间线上派生关系创建于 .716Z，而基础林岚的携带关系在 .732Z 之后才出现。可能表示变体基于「腕表携带关系加入之前」的版本，也可能只是修订哈希语义不同。
issues.suggestion: 建议在腕表问题定案后，复核一次派生的同步状态：确认变体是否需要在同一版本上重建派生关系，避免变体与新基础事实脱节。本次检查不将其判定为冲突。

issues.description: 设计建议：白色绷带与世界规则相符（纯棉、手工、明确无电子元件、无包装），也与「伤势不改变身份与已有服装」相符。但其可见规格未定：宽度、包扎层数、卷尾或固定方式是否露出、绷带卷本体是否出现在画面中均未说明。

issues.description: 缺少资料（不构成错误）：旧候车厅完整资料只有「入口、长凳区、站台门，入口与长凳区相邻，长凳区通向站台门」，sceneSpatial 状态为 missing、draft 为空，unknowns 已自记「方向基准待补充或确认；不可将镜头左/右直接当场景固定方向」「主要区域、建筑结构与固定物体尚未登记」。按用户说明，朝向、绝对尺寸与完整平面布局尚未提供，不得据此推断同轴、直线或任何方向。

reviews.summary: 范围：项目「普通城市的夜班」全部 5 个实体（林岚、旧候车厅、林岚·腕伤、白色绷带、电子腕表）及其全部关系，逐条用 get_project_entity 读取完整资料后与世界规则（普通现实城市、无魔法；不允许电子设备，所有道具是机械或手工物品；伤势不改变人物身份与已有服装）比对。结论：发现 2 条明确矛盾，均集中在"电子腕表"物品及其携带关系；另有若干缺少资料项与设计建议。相符点：白色绷带为棉布手工物品、明确"无电子元件"，符合规则；林岚·腕伤只改右手腕绷带、保留身份与灰色长外套/深蓝裤子，符合"伤势不改变人物身份与已有服装"；场景与人物未见魔法或超现实元素。按用户要求：场景朝向/尺寸/完整平面布局、人物声音均按"尚未提供"处理，不作为错误也不猜方向；本轮没有选定任何图片，因此未做也不主张任何图像一致性结论。本报告只是审阅意见，不修改任何资料，也不代表事实已确认。

steps.label: 林岚 · 脸部＋正面／背面／侧面（V3 Simple）
steps.prompt:
Composition: Clean 3:2 landscape layout on a warm off-white background with generous spacing. No frames, borders, dividers, text, labels, watermarks, or logos. Soft, even neutral studio lighting across all panels. Rendering style, line weight, texture, and shading must strictly match the reference image.
Left Column (20% width): Exactly one large, straight-on head-and-shoulders portrait of the reference subject with a neutral expression. Clearly show the face and hairstyle. No expression grid, no stacked portraits, no additional head crops.
Right Row (80% width): Exactly three full-height, identically scaled figures arranged left to right: Front View, Back View, and Clean Side Profile. Neutral relaxed stance, head to feet visible in every figure, including shoes. Soft oval floor shadows. The face portrait and all three full-body views show the same subject.
Consistency & Constraints: Preserve exact identity, hair, facial features, garments, asymmetry, and accessories from the reference. Do not add, redesign, beautify, age, or extrapolate items based on lore/profession. No extra characters, shifting proportions, extra limbs, or style drift.
Subject-specific constraints: The subject is a night-shift female administrator with short black hair that contains one lock of white hair — keep exactly one white streak, in the same position and width as the reference, with the same short black haircut. Wardrobe is fixed and must be preserved exactly: a long grey coat and dark blue trousers; do not shorten, recolor, restyle, layer, or accessorize them. No props of any kind: no electronic devices, no badge, no bag, no tools, no weapon. The subject is intact and unharmed: no blood, bandages, or injury makeup. Same warm off-white studio background, same lighting and line treatment in every panel.
steps.purpose: 建立林岚可用于跨图一致性核对的脸部特写与正面／背面／侧面全身参照；本步骤等待本实体已选主图后由人工批次执行。

steps.label: 林岚·腕伤 · 概念图（右手腕白色绷带）
steps.prompt: Character concept reference image, 3:2 landscape, ordinary realistic present-day city, no magic and no fantasy elements. Using the selected base appearance reference of the base character 林岚 as the identity source: show the same single subject, a night-shift female administrator, standing in a neutral relaxed stance, full body visible from head to feet, on a plain warm off-white background under soft even studio lighting. Preserve her exact identity, face, body proportions, and the same rendering style, line weight, texture and shading as the reference. Hair as in the reference: short black hair with exactly one lock of white hair in the same position and width — no second white lock, no highlights. Wardrobe unchanged and exactly as in the reference: a long grey coat and dark blue trousers; do not shorten, recolor, restyle, layer or accessorize them. Exactly one change from the reference: the subject's anatomical right wrist, that is her own right hand, which appears on the viewer's left in a front view, is wrapped in plain white cotton cloth bandage — a hand-made cloth wrap covering the wrist locally, matte woven fabric with visible texture and slight layering. The bandage stays on the wrist area only and must not extend over the hand or far up the forearm. Constraints: she is otherwise intact and unharmed — no blood, no cuts, no bruises, no scars, no sling, no splint, and no bandage anywhere except that one wrist. No weapons, no tools, no bags, no badge, no extra accessories. No electronic devices anywhere: every object is mechanical or hand-made. No extra characters. Neutral studio stance only: no dramatic action, no specific location, no staged camera-action pose. No text, labels, logos or watermarks.

steps.prompt: Object concept reference image, 3:2 landscape, ordinary realistic present-day city, no magic and no fantasy elements. A single plain white cotton gauze bandage roll intended for hand wrapping: a tightly rolled strip of white cotton cloth with clearly visible woven texture, soft matte fabric surface and a slightly frayed raw cut edge, plus a short length of the strip unrolled and loosely folded beside the roll so its width and layered structure read clearly. Hand-made mechanical-era object: no packaging, no box, no printed brand or text, no labels, no adhesive tape, no plastic spool, no electronic parts, no scissors, no metal clips and no safety pins shown. Studio product presentation: plain warm off-white background, soft even lighting, gentle contact shadow, centered composition with generous empty space, crisp readable material detail, no depth-of-field blur. No wound, no blood, no injured body, no hand or skin, no medical setting, no watermark and no text of any kind.
